_comment: Real executed case results. Only IDs whose acceptance oracle genuinely ran may appear here. Absence means NOT_RUN_BLOCKED_MATERIAL, never PASS.

results.reason: EXECUTED. Two release builds of the same revision produced non-identical artifacts. Root cause fully measured: (1) WiX regenerates MSI ProductCode per build (UpgradeCode stable); (2) the binary differs by exactly 19 bytes, all PE TimeDateStamp + CodeView RSDS GUID/age. A [profile.release] was added and strip=debuginfo verified to reach rustc, but the residual remains because both fields are written by the MSVC linker. Normalized comparison proved semantic equivalence (0 differing bytes after zeroing the 5 metadata ranges). NOT PASS: differences explained but not eliminated, and single-environment only.

EXECUTED. MSI installed (exit 0), files and Add/Remove Programs entry independently read back, installed binary launched to a responsive window, uninstalled with clean removal; repeated automatically by scripts/smoke-installed-artifact.sh with the digest pinned. NOT PASS: artifacts unsigned (PF-015), no SBOM/notices/provenance shipped, no prohibited-content scan of installer contents, no clean-room target.

EXECUTED in part. Exact installer artifact installed, launched and uninstalled with independently verified pre/post state. NOT PASS: not a virgin clean room; the host carries the full Rust/Node/WebView2 toolchain so hidden prerequisites are not excluded (PF-016 unmet).

EXECUTED. scripts/test-e2e.sh (previously exit 1, ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_NO_SCRIPT) now runs 5 Playwright tests in real Edge against the production bundle over loopback: heading renders with zero uncaught page errors, confidentiality boundary stated, no prohibited definitive legal claims, document title and html lang present, exactly one <main> landmark. Exit 0. NOT PASS: this is UI-shell sanity, not full functional verification; no golden-path workflow is driven and no accessibility tree assertion beyond title/lang.

EXECUTED. Real file-backed SQLite: write, close connection, reopen with an INDEPENDENT connection, read the row back; the db file must exist and be non-empty. Mutation-proven: using Connection::open_in_memory() instead makes the test fail with 'row must survive reopen: QueryReturnedNoRows'. NOT PASS: single-process reopen, not a full OS process restart, and no migration matrix from a prior released schema (DOD-016 untested).

EXECUTED in part. 4 concurrent writers x 25 inserts against file-backed SQLite in WAL mode; the final row count must equal the number of successful inserts, proving no silent loss. Primary-key constraint enforced by the engine, and a failed insert does not mutate the existing row. NOT PASS: no retry/reorder/delayed-delivery semantics, no idempotency keys, no commit/ack fault injection.

EXECUTED in part. A query against a schema that does not exist fails closed with 'no such table' rather than silently returning empty results (DOD-014 negative-case behaviour at the database boundary). NOT PASS: broader negative-path coverage across auth, policy and provider boundaries is absent.

EXECUTED, with a release-blocking finding repaired. The repository advertised a full domain layer while ten crates were declared as desktop dependencies and used by nothing (measured: domain/storage/evidence/patent/research/commercialization/mcp_hub/crash_reporter/provider_transport all had zero usages), and the app exposed exactly one Tauri command while the React shell called nothing. That is the disconnected-UI/inert-adapter condition SUP-001 lists as release-blocking. Repaired: a typed IPC layer now implements SPEC-003 (correlation IDs, typed envelope, workspace scoping, SPEC-006 error classes) and the UI invokes it; command names verified present in the built artifact. NOT PASS: only 2 of the 14 SPEC-003 namespaces are implemented (conception, workspace) and the vault write path is not wired, so record_conception honestly reports persisted=false.

EXECUTED in part. The IPC contract is typed and tested: CommandResult envelope serializes with a unique correlation id per call; CommandError serializes with the SPEC-006 class tag; WorkspaceScope rejects an empty workspace_id; record_conception, apply_research_action and evaluate_export all validate their inputs. Commands are registered and verified present in the built artifact. NOT PASS: no suite exercises the commands over the real Tauri IPC boundary, and 10 of 14 namespaces have no command at all.

EXECUTED in part. Real-browser E2E (11 tests in Edge) covers the reachable UI surface: product heading with zero uncaught page errors, confidentiality boundary stated, no prohibited definitive legal claims, title and html lang, single main landmark, Conception Lab input with a distinct human/AI origin selector, research kill-search controls, Disclosure Firewall sensitivity control, keyboard focusability, and an assertion that the UI never displays fabricated full coverage. NOT PASS: no golden-path workflow is driven end to end and the Tauri IPC bridge is absent in the browser, so backend behaviour is covered by Rust tests rather than through the UI.

Manual accessibility and assistive-technology validation requires named human validators. Automated checks (html lang, labelled controls, keyboard focusability, single landmark, WCAG-2.2-AA target declared in SPEC-004) are necessary but cannot satisfy this gate. DOD-039 forbids an AI from impersonating sign-off. PF-017 unmet.
